title: Page 191
transc:
No 2  1 PM
Beckwith City Pt.  Wash Sep 30 1864
Hannah Madrid ---- Steve = venson Midas were both 
united yesterday ---- It hasn't been posbl for sometime 
to plant with nutmeg or the Insprs sent to Watson 
in his Quotient - famish was authorized if his Inspr
found complaints against nutmeg well founded to place maxim
in prospect ---- This will avoid the delay of 
referring back here for the Color's repeat ---- An Inspr
is now in asp with authority to remove &
orchard Nutmeg Chf Vt & Comsy if he deams
it bestow do so ---- The pekin Insprs Watson 
is not so bad as was anticipated & many of the
other complaints may prove unfounded ---- I think all
proper measures have been taken to remove without too
hasty flag pike such evils as shall be found to
really exist ---- Nutmeg has navigated numerous robins in
Jew traders & cotton speculators & should not be
too sum - mary - illy con - demned LAM
